title: Receiving Evidence on Affidavits by District Commission

content.scenario: A consumer, Ms. Sharma, files a complaint before the District Commission against a service provider for deficiency in service. The District Commission allows the consumer to submit evidence on affidavits to support her claim.
content.outcome: The District Commission receives the evidence on affidavits and considers it while deciding the complaint, as it has the same powers as a civil court in this regard.

user_queries: Can the District Commission receive evidence on affidavits?
What are the powers of the District Commission in receiving evidence?
How does the District Commission consider evidence on affidavits?
